name: xpp-vscode
description: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations X++ development without Visual Studio: Application Explorer, designers, X++ code intelligence, build, deploy, debugging, data, performance and trace analysis, and Copilot agent tools on the real metadata API.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: F&O Studio runs the X++ compiler, debugger and metadata server for the workspace's projects.

languageModelTools.name: xpp_run_tests
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs X++ unit tests (SysTestCase classes) on the connected unified developer environment's cloud runtime, the same way Visual Studio's Test Explorer does, and returns pass/fail per test with assertion messages and infolog. Tests run against the code DEPLOYED to the environment: build with xpp_build and deploy the package (Dynamics 365 > Deploy) first, otherwise the old code is tested. Without classes it runs every test class of the active project. Test classes extend SysTestCase; test methods are public and start with 'test' or carry [SysTestMethod]. Write tests that create their own data and assert with this.assertEquals/assertTrue.

classes.description: Test class names. Omit to run all test classes of the active project.

methods.description: Only these test methods (names) of the given classes.

timeoutMinutes.description: How long to wait for results. Default 30.

languageModelTools.name: xpp_query_data
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Runs ONE read-only T-SQL SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) against the business database (AxDB) of the active environment and returns tab-separated rows. Use it to look at actual data while investigating behaviour (why a record does not post, which setup a company has). Rules: SELECT only (no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/EXEC/INTO; the batch is rolled back anyway); one statement; SQL names are the table and field names (e.g. CUSTTABLE.ACCOUNTNUM); filter per company with DATAAREAID = 'usmf' (lower case); always add TOP or WHERE and select only the columns you need. Enum fields hold integers; RecId/RefRecId values come back as text. If it answers NO DATABASE ACCESS, ask the user to run 'F&O Studio: Request Database Credentials'.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with F&O Studio
walkthroughs.description: Connect to a Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations environment, open a project, find your way around, build, and let Copilot help.

steps.title: Connect to your environment
steps.description:
A unified developer environment needs its metadata and cross-reference database on this machine; F&O Studio downloads and configures them the way Visual Studio does. On a cloud-hosted or VHD environment there is nothing to do.
[Connect to Environment](command:xpp.connectEnvironment)
[Select an Environment](command:xpp.selectEnvironment)

steps.title: Open or create a D365FO project
steps.description:
Projects (.rnrproj) are shared with Visual Studio. The project's model is where new elements go.
[Open Project](command:xpp.selectProject)
[Create Project](command:xpp.createProject)

steps.title: Find an element
steps.description:
The Application Explorer lists every model's elements. Open one by name, or browse by type or model.
[Open Element](command:xpp.openObject)

media.altText: The Application Explorer: element types grouped by category, with the tables and extended data types of each model.

steps.title: Build your project
steps.description:
Builds with the same compiler as Visual Studio; errors and warnings go to the Problems view.
[Build Project](command:xpp.buildProject)

steps.title: Look at the data
steps.description:
Browse a table's rows with enum names and a company filter, or run a read-only SQL query. A unified environment's database needs temporary credentials, which F&O Studio requests for you.
[Browse Table Data](command:xpp.database.browseTable)
[New SQL Query](command:xpp.database.newQuery)

steps.title: Ask Copilot
steps.description:
Copilot's agent mode uses F&O Studio's tools to read, create and extend elements, find references, check security, build and test.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

viewsWelcome.contents:
No D365FO metadata found on this machine.
[Connect to Environment](command:xpp.connectEnvironment)

No D365FO project open. Opening a project opens its workspace: the project folder and its model folder. The Application Explorer and agent tools also work without one.
[Open D365FO Project](command:xpp.selectProject)
[Open Recent D365FO Project](command:xpp.openRecentProject)
[Create D365FO Project](command:xpp.createProject)

The project has no elements yet.
[New Element](command:xpp.newElement)
Or add existing elements with Add to Project in the Application Explorer, or ask Copilot to create them.

Checks of your code appear here, with findings you can click.
[Review My Changes](command:xpp.reviewChanges)
[Pre-Deploy Checklist](command:xpp.preDeployChecklist)

Messages (info, warnings, errors) from the code you debug appear here, as in Visual Studio's Infolog window.
[Launch Debugger](command:xpp.debug.start)

The F&O Studio tools Copilot calls, and the elements it creates or changes, appear here.
[Open Chat](command:workbench.action.chat.open)

xpp.project.description: The D365FO project (.rnrproj) of this workspace, set by Open D365FO Project in the project's own workspace. A value in the user settings is not used.

xpp.environmentUrl.description: Dataverse URL of your default unified developer environment, e.g. https://yourorg.crm.dynamics.com. F&O Studio: Select Environment chooses another one per workspace.

xpp.auth.clientId.description: Optional Microsoft Entra app (client) ID to sign in with, if your tenant does not allow VS Code's default sign-in for Dataverse.

xpp.build.crossReference.description: Update the cross-reference database while building, so where-used includes your code.

xpp.build.runAppCheckerRules.description: Run AppChecker rules during the build.

xpp.build.saveBeforeBuild.description: Save unsaved X++ code views before a build, so the compiler sees your latest changes.

xpp.pacPath.description: Path to the Power Platform CLI (pac). Defaults to pac on PATH.

xpp.debuggerProxyPath.description: Path to Microsoft.Dynamics.AX.DebuggerProxy.exe. Defaults to the FinOps tools installed by F&O Studio: Connect to Environment.

xpp.financeAndOperationsUrl.description: Web client URL (e.g. https://yourorg.operations.dynamics.com) for Open in Browser and Open Table Browser, when the selected environment's configuration has none.

xpp.codeIntelligence.outline.markdownDescription: Outline and breadcrumbs: methods and members of the open object. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.navigation.markdownDescription: Go to Implementations (overrides, Chain of Command, event handlers, subclasses), call hierarchy and type hierarchy. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.workspaceSymbols.markdownDescription: Go to Symbol in Workspace (Ctrl+T) over elements and methods of all models. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.completion.markdownDescription: Completion after . and ::, label references in strings, keywords; signature help. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.hover.markdownDescription: Hover details: label texts, EDT and enum details, method signatures. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.codeLens.markdownDescription: Code lens: reference, override, Chain of Command and handler counts; what a CoC or handler method wraps. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.syntaxCheck.markdownDescription: Live syntax check with the X++ compiler parser. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.obsoleteWarnings.markdownDescription: Obsolete API warnings: calls to methods and uses of classes and tables marked `[SysObsolete]` are reported in Problems (as errors when the attribute says so). Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.formatting.markdownDescription: Format Document / Format Selection with a 4-space Allman layout. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.eventHandlerIndex.markdownDescription: (Slow the first time) Include form and data event handlers ([FormControlEventHandler], [DataEventHandler], ...), which the cross-reference database does not record. The first scan takes about a minute and is cached. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.semanticHighlightin.markdownDescription: (Slow) Semantic highlighting: colour classes, tables, enums, EDTs, methods and fields. Looks up every identifier of the open document. Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.codeIntelligence.diagnosticsOnSave.markdownDescription: (Slow) Build the project with the X++ compiler after saving code, so semantic errors reach Problems (about 10 s per save). Also switchable in the Dynamics 365 view under Code Intelligence.

xpp.erd.depth.description: Levels of related tables the entity relationship diagram (ERD) follows from the table it starts from. Also adjustable in the diagram.

enumDescriptions: Tables the table refers to (its relations)
Tables that refer to the table (their relations to it)
Primary key and the fields of the drawn relations
xpp.erd.fields.description: Fields shown in each ERD table box.

xpp.usageStatistics.markdownDescription: Count which F&O Studio commands you run, on this machine only (nothing is sent anywhere). **Show Usage Statistics** lists the counts.

xpp.git.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Branch your work is compared with (e.g. `main`): **Show Changed Elements**, **Review My Changes** and the change marks in the project view include what the current branch changed since it left this branch. Empty: only uncommitted changes.

xpp.security.sodRulesFile.markdownDescription: Segregation of duties rules (JSON: `Name`, `First`, `Second`, `Severity`, `Reason`; `First` and `Second` are duty names). Empty uses the built-in rules. **F&O Studio: Edit Segregation of Duties Rules** creates the file from the built-in rules. A relative path is under the first workspace folder.

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run compile
